final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), order_total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count FROM customer_orders) SELECT c.customer_id, c.order_count, 1.0 * c.order_count / t.total_count FROM customer_orders AS c JOIN order_total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1.0 * c.order_count / t.total_count DESC LIMIT 10
